correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated subsets of each P_n by increasing cardinality, retaining dominating sets only when they contained no previously retained set. Enumerating membership traces by support size reproduced the VC sequence 0,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,4,4,4, with 48 shattered four-sets and no shattered five-set on P_11. Directly checked every leaf, query and branch of the frozen adaptive_trees.json against the independently enumerated concepts. The verified depths are 0,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,4,4,5 and the class sizes 1,2,2,4,4,7,9,13,18,25,36 each exclude the next depth by the one-concept-per-leaf bound. In the join every pendant/support pair contributes exactly one selected vertex, so no new edge is needed for domination inside any module. That selected vertex keeps the pendant as private neighbor, and any selected vertex outside the pair can use only private neighbors other than the changed support vertices. This gives a two-way concept-class equality, not just a check of some product members. VC additivity follows from independent traces; Littlestone additivity follows by tree concatenation and by choosing a rank-decreasing branch in the queried factor. The resulting connected tree has 11s vertices and at most two additional edges at each support. The first-gap exclusion concerns paths only.

originality.rationale: The Oct. 26 Resultary record directly covers the first path gap, the exact 36-concept count and all displayed dimension formulas on the disjoint union. Rote's gluing observation identifies the entire minimal-dominating-set family before and after each pendant-support join. The connected-tree version is consequently the same Boolean concept class on the same vertex domain, not merely a different example with an analogous inequality. No distinct substantive remainder is established by the general arbitrary-edges wording of the auxiliary gluing lemma.
residual_risks: The search does not establish comprehensive historical priority; the inspected earlier catalogue statement and primary gluing proof already settle coverage of the claimed formulas.

value.rationale: The base path boundary is a natural mathematical question, but it is an exact recomputation of an existing result. The candidate new connected-tree example preserves exactly the already analyzed product concept class by a published gluing rule. The resulting change of graph realization is a routine consequence, without a new threshold, obstruction or nontrivial extension established here.
